title: Agents that Live with You

venue.name: 10200 San Pedro Avenue
venue.address: 10200 San Pedro Ave, San Antonio, TX 78216, USA, San Antonio, TX, 78216

description: This session is for builders, developers, and AI-curious folks who want a clearer picture of what persistent agents are actually useful for. We'll look at OpenClaw, Hermes, Grok Bot, Muse, and Dots, where they overlap and where they differ, and walk through practical workflows for agents that stick around and handle ongoing work. It is a short frame and a few demos, then the room. You'll leave with a better sense of which tool fits which kind of problem, a few concrete ideas you could try, and if you want to try one, Patrick will help you sketch a setup before you leave.
